verdict.rationale: Jan documents an OpenAI-compatible local API server powered by llama.cpp, with chat completions that support streaming, tool calling and multi-turn conversations. Nothing in the evidence documents grammar-constrained decoding, JSON mode, response_format or JSON-schema enforcement. Tool calling and the underlying llama.cpp engine are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can constrain model output to structured formats like JSON using grammars
